title: How Does An MRI Scan See Inside Your Brain? 🧠
description: Discover how an MRI machine looks inside your body without surgery or harmful radiation. Learn the amazing physics behind it in under a minute.

scenes.say: How does an MRI machine capture precise details of your brain without any surgery or harmful X-rays?

scenes.caption: Water molecules in the body
scenes.say: The human body is full of water. Water contains hydrogen atoms that act like tiny magnetic compasses.

scenes.label: Stronger than Earth's magnet
scenes.say: The device contains a giant magnet, twenty thousand times stronger than Earth's magnetic field, forcing all these tiny compasses to line up in one direction.
Then the machine sends short radio pulses, knocking the atoms off track. When they snap back, they send signals that a computer turns into incredible images.
Ever noticed the loud noise inside the machine? That happens because electric current presses on the magnetic coils and vibrates at high speed.
